newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson, property boost Swedish shares.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson, property boost Swedish shares.

text.p: Lively trade in telecoms group Ericsson dominated a bullish Stockholm share market on Wednesday morning which was boosted by overseas trends and lower bond yields in early trade.
The market's general index rose 0.52 percent to 2,150.55 in turnover of 2.4 billion crowns.
Ericsson rose two crowns to 191 after touching a record of 192.50 crowns.
"Lately there has been a string of good news about Ericsson. A technical buy signal exists at 191 crowns and that attracts still more buyers," one broker said.
The property sector index made the most gains, rising 2.2 percent.
Commercial bank Swedbank rose 1.50 crown to 107.50 after the bank posted a 23 percent rise in operating profit of 3.82 billion crowns for the first nine month of the year.
